name: Son clave and cowbell interlock
desc: The heartbeat of salsa: an explicit son clave 3-2 (vcsl clave) whose two bars alternate via angle-brackets, interlocked with a mambo cowbell riding steady eighths with wrist accents. Cabasa 16ths pump and sweep, a woodblock euclid rotates, and a guiro scrape answers at peak.

code.full: stack(s("clave").struct("<[x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~] [~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ ~]>").gain(${gain}).room(.3).pan(.45), s("cb*8").gain("[.42 .24 .36 .26 .4 .24 .36 .28]").hpf(600).pan(sine.range(.5, .66).slow(16)), s("cabasa*16").gain(saw.range(${shk}*.4, ${shk}).fast(4)).hpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*1.5).slow(24)).pan(cosine.range(.34, .5).slow(16)), s("woodblock(3,8,<2 4>)").gain(${gain}*.5).speed(1.1).pan(.66)).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("clave").struct("<[x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~] [~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ ~]>").gain(${gain}).room(.3).pan(.45), s("cb*8").gain("[.45 .26 .38 .28 .43 .26 .38 .3]").hpf(600).pan(sine.range(.48, .68).slow(12)), s("cabasa*16").gain(saw.range(${shk}*.5, ${shk}).fast(4)).hpf(sine.range(${cut}*1.1, ${cut}*1.7).slow(16)).pan(cosine.range(.32, .5).slow(12)), s("woodblock(5,8,<0 2 4>)").gain(${gain}*.5).speed(1.1).pan(.66), s("guiro(3,8,2)").gain(${gain}*.55).speed(1.05).room(.2).pan(.3)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(2).play()
